message.content: {"caption":"Line chart comparing knowledge incorporation across reinforcement-learning iterations with four constant baselines.","description":"The chart is titled “Single-Passage Knowledge Incorporation.” The x-axis is ReST-EM RL Training Iterations, with ticks at 0, 1, and 2; the y-axis is Knowledge Incorporation (%) and spans approximately 32% to 47%. Four dashed horizontal series remain constant across the plotted iterations: Qwen 2.5 7B Base at about 32.7%, Raw Passage at about 33.5%, Qwen-Base Synthetic at about 39.7%, and GPT-4.1 Synthetic at about 46.3%. The solid coral SEAL series, marked with open circles, rises from about 39.7% at iteration 0 to 42.7% at iteration 1 and 47.0% at iteration 2. It begins level with the Qwen-Base Synthetic baseline, rises above it, and ends above the GPT-4.1 Synthetic baseline.
